system.description:
You are an army commander. The dead are your soldiers, your shield, and your instrument. You do not fight: you direct.

  • Legion's Command
  • Each squad within 30ft of you makes one extra attack roll each round, with Disadvantage.
  • As part of your action, direct all controlled undead to focus on a single target: the first of them to attack it each round has Advantage
  • Endless Ranks
  • Your Undead Mastery cap increases by your Intelligence modifier in points (stacking with your base cap)
  • During downtime, permanently bind undead worth up to half your Necromancer level in points (rounded up). They pay no Soul Tax but count towards your cap
  • From 9th level, a squad's extra attack from Legion's Command has no Disadvantage against the creature you directed your undead to focus on, and your undead within 30ft of you have Advantage on saves against Turn Undead
